how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for WDRA Under Secretary (Technical) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.wdra.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) for filling up technical positions under central government guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Under Secretary (Technical) under recruitment advertisement number WDRA-HR0Dep(UST)/1/2023-HR/1826.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this WDRA recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Under Secretary (Technical) post on a deputation basis across India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the offline application form is 12 November 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Under Secretary (Technical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in any Biological Sciences (including Agriculture) from a Government recognized University with relevant regular service experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit prescribed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as per the deputation guidelines mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Under Secretary (Technical) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level-11 ranging from Rs.67,700 to Rs.2,08,700/- under the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for WDRA Under Secretary Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled applications through post to the designated address in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted to the Deputy Director (Human Resource), Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority, NCUI Building, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form by visiting the official website at www.wdra.gov.in or using the links provided above.
